NewsFeedTexts.m_Text: Caffeinated AF [CAF] is meant to be a balance between survival, exploration, and combat. This is a work in progress, so you may find bugs or other issues. Visit the discord for questions, comments, or concerns. Click the Discord icon below.
Read the Tips and Tricks section of your logbook to learn how to survive better in Takistan. Open your logbook in-game with the B key.
